title: Windows Update stuck

character.name: Zubair
character.personality: patient, but running out of time

symptom: PC has shown 'Working on updates' at the same percentage for hours
user_description: My PC has said 'Working on updates, 30 percent' since this morning. It hasn't moved. Is it broken?

options.text: Hold the power button to switch it off after a few minutes
options.why: Cutting power in the middle of an update can corrupt Windows. Updates can take a long time, so waiting is the first step.
Leaves the PC without security fixes. It treats a stuck update as a reason to stop patching altogether.

options.text: Allow plenty of time and watch for disk activity; if there is still no progress after a long wait, restart, run the Windows Update troubleshooter and check free disk space
options.why: Updates can look stuck while they are still working, so patience comes first. If nothing happens after a long wait, a restart, the built-in troubleshooter and enough free space fix most stuck updates.
Far too drastic. Most stuck updates can be fixed without wiping the PC.

hints: Can a long update look frozen even though it is still working?
How could you tell whether the PC is still doing something?
If it really is stuck, what built-in tool is designed to repair update problems?
real_world_tip: A flashing disk light or a spinning wheel means it is still working. Only act once you are sure it has stopped.
